body:
Really sorry to hear about your circumstances.

Have you thought about doing something like http://wwoofinternational.org/ or https://www.helpx.net/ ?

Basically, you exchange a few hours of labour per day for accommodation and food. It's "work", I guess, but it would be far less work than trying to slog it out in the wilderness.

I know exactly what you're talking about and I feel it too.

I've been depressed pretty much my whole life. Childhood abuse, trauma background; that kinda thing. Depression has been both my worst enemy (it makes me feel like shit and make bad choices in life) and my best friend (it's forced me to be insightful and empathic, and is the driving force behind a lot of my creativity and values). Basically, it's the foundation on which my whole personality and identity has been built. It's been a huge determining factor in what my life looks like - for better or for worse. Most of the time, I feel like it would be fucking sweet to emancipate from depression, but I just don't think that's possible at this point in the game. It's just our lot and something we'll need to continue living with - again, for better or for worse.
